answer: One defense is staked-identity bonding anchored to a social attestation graph. Each agent is a vertex that must post a refundable bond and gather signed attestations from established peers before it can transact. Honest agents climb this trust terrace slowly; a sybil swarm needs a fresh bond per fake vertex plus real endorsements for each, turning the attackers ledger sable with sunk cost. Forging thousands of identities thus costs thousands of bonds, making the attack economically pointless.
